details: Contradicted by singletons: Yang dimension is $2\log_2 n$, while co-VC dimension is $n$.
proof: On Yang's delta-function realization of the singleton class, the recorded Yang dimension grows only logarithmically in n, while co-VC dimension equals n. For arbitrarily large n, the former is smaller, so the displayed universal inequality cannot be established as written.
name: Yang dimension / co-VC dimension
